content.value_statement: Flutter localization setup requires coordinated dependency, generator, resource, and app configuration changes. This skill guides those changes with examples for strings, placeholders, plurals, and selects.
actual_capabilities: Adds the Flutter localization and internationalization dependencies.
Enables localization code generation in the Flutter project configuration.
Creates an l10n configuration for ARB input and generated output.
Configures localization delegates and supported locales for MaterialApp or CupertinoApp.
Guides ARB strings, typed placeholders, plurals, selects, generation, and widget usage.
limitations: The examples show English and Spanish; additional locales require appropriate translations.
Default paths and synthetic package imports may require changes for customized projects.
The skill does not verify linguistic quality or regional appropriateness.
Locale persistence, runtime switching, and localization integration tests are outside its scope.

use_cases.title: Initialize a new application
use_cases.description: Create the dependencies, configuration, base resources, delegates, and supported locales needed for a localized Flutter application.
use_cases.target_user: Flutter developers starting a new application

use_cases.title: Localize an existing interface
use_cases.description: Move visible strings into ARB resources and connect generated localization accessors to existing widgets.
use_cases.target_user: Mobile teams updating an existing Flutter codebase

use_cases.title: Build dynamic messages
use_cases.description: Define typed placeholders, plural forms, and conditional selections for data-driven interface text.
use_cases.target_user: Product engineers implementing dynamic localized messages

prompt_templates.title: Initialize localization
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up Flutter localization in this project for English and Spanish. Use the existing project structure and summarize every changed file.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new Flutter application

prompt_templates.title: Add localized content
prompt_templates.prompt: Add localized strings for [screen] in [locales]. Include descriptions, update every ARB file, generate classes, and report validation errors.
prompt_templates.scenario: Add translations to an existing screen

prompt_templates.title: Create dynamic messages
prompt_templates.prompt: Create ARB messages for [feature] with typed placeholders and plurals. Update widgets to use generated localization methods and preserve existing naming conventions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Implement parameterized and quantity-aware interface text

prompt_templates.title: Audit the localization setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Flutter localization setup for configuration, delegate, locale, ARB, placeholder, plural, and generated import problems. Fix verified issues and run validation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of an established localized application

output_examples.input: Set up localization for English and Spanish.
output: Added the required localization dependencies and enabled generation.
Created the localization configuration and base resource files.
Configured app delegates and supported locales.

output_examples.input: Add a notification count message with correct plural forms.
output: Added a quantity-aware message with zero, one, and other forms.
Declared the count placeholder and updated the widget call.
Regenerated localization classes and checked for resource errors.
Compared project configuration, resources, delegates, and generated imports.
Corrected confirmed inconsistencies while preserving project conventions.
Reported remaining translation and testing boundaries.

best_practices: Add descriptive metadata so translators understand each string context.
Keep placeholder names and types consistent across every locale resource.
Run generation after resource changes and resolve all reported syntax errors.
anti_patterns: Do not leave user-visible strings embedded directly in widgets.
Do not change placeholder names between locale files.
Do not assume generated import paths match every project configuration.

faq.question: Which Flutter packages does this skill configure?
faq.answer: It configures flutter_localizations from the Flutter SDK and the intl package.

faq.question: Which resource format does it use?
faq.answer: It uses ARB files as inputs for Flutter localization generation.

faq.question: Can it configure MaterialApp and CupertinoApp?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains the delegates and supported locales required by either application widget.

faq.question: Does it support placeholders and plurals?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers typed placeholders, plural forms, and conditional select messages.

faq.question: Does it translate application text?
faq.answer: It can structure locale resources, but professional translation quality requires qualified review.

faq.question: Will every Flutter project use the same generated import?
faq.answer: No. Projects with custom generation settings may need different output paths and imports.
